rw_faq.question: How much does it cost to submit to Genify?
rw_faq.answer: Free with a link back to them and a stated 72-hour review. Pro $4.90 once drops the backlink, adds featured placement at the top and a social and newsletter share.

rw_faq.question: Does a Genify listing provide a dofollow link?
rw_faq.answer: Yes, a dofollow link on a domain rated 33.

rw_faq.question: Do I need to link back to Genify?
rw_faq.answer: Yes on free — the backlink is the stated condition.

rw_faq.question: What gets a listing rejected?
rw_faq.answer: A tool that generates nothing, or a free submission without the backlink.

rw_eligibility: You need to pay and a real tool. Shortened URLs, redirects and affiliate links are discarded automatically; closed betas, waitlists, library sites and newsletters are refused by name, as are poorly built sites.
rw_submit_steps: 1 Read the rules before the form: search for an existing listing, direct HTTPS URLs only, AI tools only, no closed betas or waitlists, nothing poorly built.
2 Pay $69. One price, one tier. Google sign-in exists in the header but the listing itself is the purchase.
rw_submit_requirements: A $69 one-time payment
A direct HTTPS URL and tool details
rw_rejection_reasons: Shortened URLs, redirects and affiliate links — discarded automatically; closed betas and waitlists; library sites and newsletters; malfunctioning or poorly built sites

Closed beta and waitlist products are refused by name, ruling out submitting ahead of launch.
Newsletters and library sites are refused too — a content product that merely uses AI is not what they mean by an AI tool.
